# SipFit

SipFit is a bottle-first hydration and reusable water bottle hygiene tracker.

Website: https://sipfit.app/
App: https://sipfit.app/app/
Blog: https://sipfit.app/blog/

## What SipFit Helps With

- Track hydration by bottle.
- Log water, electrolytes, protein, coffee, tea, sugary drinks, and other drinks.
- Know when to rinse, wash, or deep clean reusable bottles.
- Track bottle-specific cleaning history for Owala FreeSip, YETI Rambler, Stanley Quencher, Hydro Flask, and custom bottles.

## Key Guides

- When to wash a reusable water bottle: https://sipfit.app/blog/when-to-wash-your-water-bottle
- Owala FreeSip cleaning: https://sipfit.app/blog/owala-freesip-cleaning-guide
- YETI Rambler cleaning: https://sipfit.app/blog/yeti-rambler-cleaning-guide
- Easy-clean bottle buying guide: https://sipfit.app/blog/best-water-bottle-easy-cleaning-guide
- Water bottle smell prevention: https://sipfit.app/blog/water-bottle-smell-prevention

## Short Cleaning Guidance

- Water: wash daily if used daily.
- Electrolytes: wash same day.
- Protein or milk-based drinks: rinse as soon as possible and wash same day.
- Coffee or tea: wash same day.
- Sugary drinks: wash same day.
- Lids, straws, gaskets, and mouthpieces need more attention than the bottle body.

## Sources Used In SipFit Guides

- Cleveland Clinic reusable bottle hygiene guidance.
- AP reporting on reusable bottle cleaning.
- FDA, CDC, and USDA food-safety guidance for perishable residue timing.
- Owala, YETI, Hydro Flask, Stanley, and Consumer Reports cleaning guidance.
